# มดแดง Mot Dang

> A Thai-first, open, 1997-style city directory for Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai —
> wats, food, hotels, doctors, markets, real estate, and the good things down
> every soi. Built from OpenStreetMap plus community and field submissions.
> 7,044 places as of 2026-07-27.

## Open data (no key, no login)
- Full search index: https://motdang.net/data/index.json
- Per-category GeoJSON: https://motdang.net/data/<province>-<category>.geojson
  (province = cm | cr; e.g. https://motdang.net/data/cm-wat.geojson)
- Category tree source: https://github.com/NaNoBotCo/mot-dang/blob/main/data/categories.json
- Dataset stats: https://motdang.net/stats.html

## URL structure
- https://motdang.net/<province>/<category>/ — category listing
- https://motdang.net/<province>/<category>/<subcategory>/ — subcategory listing
- https://motdang.net/<province>/p/<id>.html — one place, with schema.org JSON-LD
- https://motdang.net/contacts.html — where contact-info coverage is thin
- https://motdang.net/suggest.html, https://motdang.net/crawl-request.html — how to contribute

## Notes for crawlers and agents
- No login, no paywall, no tracking scripts, no rate limiting. Crawl freely.
- Content updates as the community and gentle OSM crawls contribute.
- Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) for map-derived fields.
- Contact-info coverage is currently 18% — corrections and
  additions via GitHub issues are welcome and go live on the next build.
